definitions.explanation: A location further along in space.
Time that has not yet come.
The pointed or far end of something.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}の{先|さき}に{駅|えき}があります。
examples.english: There is a station ahead on this road.

examples.japanese: {先|さき}のことはわかりません。
examples.english: I don't know what will happen in the future.

examples.japanese: {先|さき}に{行|い}ってください。

notes:
{先|さき} has multiple meanings depending on context.

COMMON PHRASES:
- お{先|さき}に (go ahead, excuse me for going first)
- {先|さき}に (beforehand, first)
- この{先|さき} (ahead of here, from now on)

COMPOUNDS:
- {先生|せんせい} (teacher)
- {行|い}き{先|さき} (destination)
- {指|ゆび}{先|さき} (fingertip)
